title: Analysis scripts and processed data for: An integrated metatranscriptomic study of viruses, bacteria and host transcriptional signatures in nasal swabs from pre-weaned dairy calves with and without respiratory disease
description: R scripts and processed input data used to analyse nasal swab metatranscriptomes (viruses, bacteria and host transcriptome) from pre-weaned dairy calves in Australia: PERMANOVA, hurdle mixed models, host differential expression (limma-voom), host-taxon correlation networks, gene annotation and figures. Code: MIT licence; data in input_files/: CC BY 4.0. Raw reads: NCBI BioProject PRJNA1191164.
